headline: ME-Brain reports memory-guided improvement across simulated and small-scale robot tasks
summary: Li Auto’s ME-Brain technical report describes an embodied system combining an external multimodal memory, a cognitive module and an action model, and reports comparisons on RoboMME, RoboDojo and six physical manipulation tasks. These are author-reported results: the real-robot evaluation used a Piper dual-arm platform and 10 trials per task. No independent reproduction, released artifact or broad deployment result is established here.
